title: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy golden dosa filled with a gently spiced potato masala.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Heat oil; splutter mustard seeds, cook onions, then add turmeric and mashed potatoes.

steps.title: Spread the dosa
steps.text: Pour batter onto a hot tawa and spread into a thin circle.

steps.title: Cook until crisp
steps.text: Cook until golden around the edges.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Add potato masala, fold, and serve with chutney.

tips: A well-heated tawa helps produce a crisp dosa.
